problemSigns.sign: Door sticks or binds at the same spot every time
problemSigns.detail: The garage door stops or catches at the same point during opening or closing. This indicates a consistent obstruction or bend in the track.

problemSigns.sign: Visible bend or dent in the track
problemSigns.detail: You can see a deformation in the metal track itself. Even small bends prevent rollers from moving freely and smoothly.

problemSigns.sign: Rollers popping out of the track
problemSigns.detail: One or more garage door rollers disengage from the track. This often causes the door to hang crooked, jam, or fall off completely.

problemSigns.sign: Gap between track and door frame
problemSigns.detail: The track is no longer flush with the garage door frame. This suggests loose mounting brackets, damaged fasteners, or a misaligned track section.
